title: Collider constraints on electroweak-multiplet inelastic dark matter after the LZ event
question: Do LEP and LHC searches allow the Higgsino-like (doublet) and wino-like (triplet) masses and splittings that fit the LZ event, and what would HL-LHC and future colliders add?
headline_result: The LZ-fitting Higgsino (mu >= 259 GeV, delta 310-376 keV) has Delta m+- = 342 +- 10 MeV at 1 TeV (c tau 0.71 cm, tau 0.024 ns), independent of delta to 0.19%; this lifetime is 1e7 times too short for pixel-tracklet searches (P(r>12 cm) = 5e-8 at beta gamma = 1), soft-lepton searches need Delta m >~ 5 GeV, and LEP/monojet reach lies below the 259 GeV floor, so every P007 fit point including the thermal 1.1 TeV Higgsino is allowed and unprobed by LEP, LHC and HL-LHC; only FCC-hh or a 10 TeV muon collider would reach it.

model_or_mechanism: P016 few-bin joint likelihood (200-270 keV bin n=1 b_H=5.695e-4; digitised Fig. 5 low-energy NR-band bins with theta nuisance; empty 125-200 keV bin) with exact coupling marginalisation L/L0 = e^-s (1 + rho s/b_H) W(mu) under log-uniform/uniform/Jeffreys priors on s or on total ROI events mu; in-window shape factor rho from 23 keV resolution; model priors uniform/classes/physics-weighted/raw/heavy; continuous-delta integration to the kinematic ceiling; posterior entropy; Poisson posterior predictive

title: Relativistic operator matching for the LZ-preferred nonrelativistic operators with directdm

title: Decisive tests and a falsifiable forecast for LZ's next release: what the community should expect to see, and what would kill each interpretation
question: Which observations decide the origin of the 248 keV event, when, with what probability under each hypothesis, and what falsifies each surviving interpretation?
headline_result: Under the corpus posterior LZ's next 2.8 t.yr holds >=1 event in 200-270 keV with P=0.25 (background 5.6e-4), yet a lone event leaves P(DM)=0.025 (BF 300 vs background, 0.67 vs steady unknown); only two events with one above 270 keV (P(DM) 0.57-0.99) or an event in XENONnT/PandaX-4T (P(>=1)=0.71-0.94 at best fit) confirm; delta>=366 keV dies with LZ's extended sideband (P(0)=1.2e-4 with the untouched data); zero events push P(DM)<1e-3 by Aug 2027 (L10)/Nov 2030 (d300)
model_or_mechanism: synthesis: Poisson/Gamma-Poisson counting, P061/P081 hypothesis mixture, P088 null-branch recipe, exact-Poisson discovery; all rates from corpus (P069/P088/P081/P016/P038/P079)
confidence: medium - statistics reproduce P081/P088/P079 to <=0.013 in probability; rates, hypothesis weights and calendar are inherited corpus judgements
agent_tools: Read x31, Bash x17, Write x4, Edit x16, Skill (dataviz) x1
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13; numpy 2.5.3; scipy 1.18.1 (stats.gamma/nbinom/poisson/norm, optimize.brentq); pandas 3.0.5; matplotlib 3.11.2; common/lzcommon.py (LZ dict)
local_inputs: PAPER_GUIDE; ledger (88 rows); papers P081/P088/P079/P069/P082/P093/P034/P050/P057/P038/P061/P083/P086/P072/P076/P052 (+headers P089/P092/P096/P097); work tables P081/P088/P069; data_requests/index.csv; provenance/P088.json
recalled_knowledge: 3 (Gamma-Poisson predictive; exact-Poisson Z and 5-sigma threshold; decimal-year to month), all certain
data_dependence: none (artefact kill condition provisional pending DR-003 via P093)

title: Two weeks after: a critical review of the interpretations of the LZ 248 keV event
question: Where does the evidence stand across the twelve categories after 99 corpus papers, where is the corpus internally inconsistent, which results rest on uncertain recalled numbers or pending data requests, is the collective stance biased, and what did the corpus fail to ask?
headline_result: Across 99 papers the event is established as a genuine single nuclear recoil at 246-248 +- 11 keV on the plateau with every modelled background excluded by >= 10^3.6, yet P(DM) ranges 0.015 (P061/P083) to 0.25 (P091) purely with the prior, 81 of 99 papers are 'neutral', 5 'support DM' only by elimination and none 'favours background'; five convention inconsistencies (halo frame x1.08-10, best-fit rate x2.9, sigma_E 23 vs 11 keV, wall lambda 4.3 vs 1.2 cm = 0.4 sigma, P(DM) prior x17) and seven unasked LZ-only questions are identified
key_numbers: stances 81/13/5/0 (neutral/stat/supports/favours); confidence 29 high, 69 medium, 1 low; halo frame 9 Sun-only, 8 annual-only, 10 both; best-fit spread 0.352 vs 0.121 events/t.yr (x2.9); sigma_E 23 vs 11.4 keV; wall lambda 4.3 vs 1.23 cm; provisional pending DRs 6 papers; 67/99 cite an 'uncertain' recalled item, 1152 items declared; P(DM) 0.015/0.012/0.25 (P061/P083/P091); artefact class 0.64; neighbourhood background 3.5e-4 -> 9.4e-4
model_or_mechanism: critical review; per-category verdict table; tallies of stance/confidence/DR dependence from the ledger; halo-frame convention scan; no new physics computed
stance: neutral (review: genuine nuclear recoil established; dark-matter reading prior-dominated)
confidence: medium - tallies exact; verdicts and bias assessment are expert judgement on self-declared labels
builds_on: LZ arXiv:2609.02823; whole corpus P001-P099 (35 pages read in full, 99 ledger rows); DR-001/002/003
